why_a_second_prediction_file: prediction.json was registered in pass 1 and is not touched. This file adds the items pass 3 identified from source and from a sibling row's committed screen, and it is committed BEFORE the capture that prices them exists. The campaign's two worst rows predicted 3.04 s and 4.908 s and delivered -0.0214 s and 0.156 s, and both were only caught because the prediction was written first.

items.name: program_cache_clear
items.site: tt_bio/boltz2.py:5731 - Boltz2.forward calls dev.disable_and_clear_program_cache() then enable_program_cache() on EVERY forward unless TT_BIO_BOLTZ2_KEEP_PROGRAM_CACHE=1
items.claim: The clear itself is microseconds. Its cost is the REBUILD of every program the fold then uses, which a profiler books inside whichever device-call region touches each program first, not against the clear. So this item is invisible to the region tree and to any per-op device view, and it can only be priced by an A/B on the flag.
items.condition: The lever is worth zero in a one-fold-per-process protocol, because the first forward after process start rebuilds the cache either way. It is worth the full rebuild only when the timed fold is an in-process REPEAT after an earlier fold has already warmed the cache. decomp.py folds 24 times in one process, so its own rep-1-vs-rep-2 spread at a fixed clock measures this directly, and the cacheclear arm times the clear call to separate the two.
items.prior_evidence: perf/boltz2-affinity-fixedcost/results/screen_walls.txt, another row's committed screen at 256 aa with the affinity pipeline: warm same-shape second target, structure stage 15.1 s with the clear against 12.8 s with it suppressed, a 2.3 s delta. Its cold first target moved 27.7 -> 13.7 s, which cannot be a clear-vs-no-clear difference on a cold cache and is therefore not used as the prediction.
items.refuted_if: the bare arm's rep-2 fold is not faster than rep 1 by more than the session A/A floor, at both clocks
items.clock_class_predicted: CLOCK-IMMUNE if it exists at all: program build is host-side work against the dispatch path
items.reducible: yes, and by a flag that already ships. Suppressing it needs an argument about stale program-cache state across variable shapes, which is why the flag exists and defaults to off. Accuracy risk: none to the numbers the model computes; the risk is a wrong-shape program being reused, which is a correctness question for a multi-shape process, not a precision one.

items.name: reset_static_cache_walk
items.site: tt_bio/boltz2.py, Boltz2.forward: for m in self.modules(): if hasattr(m, 'reset_static_cache'): m.reset_static_cache()
items.claim: A full module walk on every forward. Once per fold, so it is bounded by one traversal of the module tree plus whatever each reset does.
items.refuted_if: forward's own exclusive F exceeds 0.15 s and the walk is the reason
items.reducible: partly. The walk is invariant across folds of the same shape but the caches it clears are per-protein, so it cannot simply be deleted.

items.name: PairConditioningDevice_host_body
items.site: one call per fold, measured in pass 2 at 109.29 ms of host against 21.29 ms of device kernel, 16.30 percent in-kernel
items.claim: Pass 2 already priced this off c12-profiled-fold's bare walls. It is the densest host block in any device unit and it is still only 0.73 percent of the fold.
items.refuted_if: the region tree's cond_device exclusive F falls outside the band
items.reducible: at most 0.11 s, so it cannot fund the 1.0100 s bar on its own

items.name: featurisation_and_writer
items.site: regions prepare, to_batch, write_result in perf/b2x_host_residual/host_residual.py's tree
items.claim: These are host Python by construction and they are the largest part of the 1.3348 s that no device unit named in pass 2.
items.refuted_if: the three regions sum outside the band
items.clock_class_predicted: CLOCK-IMMUNE, and this is the one place the clock control should confirm rather than discriminate
items.reducible: prepare is reducible if it recomputes anything invariant across recycles; write_result is irreducible WORK but reducible COST if it sits on the critical path and need not
